name: Shannon Entropy Disruption Radar
description: An informational gravity meter. Authentic optical imagery inherently possesses an organically shifting mass of informational chaos (Entropy): grass is chaotic, sky is serene. Conversely, Generative AI networks or Photoshop manipulation violently tear this balance apart. They consistently leave behind microscopic junkyards of fractured pixels, or conversely, suffocating flat voids resulting from hyper-smoothing. This radar measures that exact thermodynamic suffocation.
algorithm: Shannon Thermodynamic Pixel Variance & Anomaly Detection
mechanism: Dragging a microscopic window across every millimeter, the engine calculates whether the sheer volume of packed information obeys physical scattering. Spliced an AI face onto a real body? The engine screams the exact moment the face registers as a thermodynamically dead, sterile plastic void while the adjacent hairline explodes with complex chaotic data. That razor-sharp disparity in Entropy continuity is an immediate death sentence.
parameters: Operator: Shannon Entropy Equation, Sliding Core: 9x9/15x15 Window, Topography: Local Histogram Mass
accuracy: Solid (75-84%) - A brutal tyrant specialized in hunting down the greasy, inorganic garbage artifacts hallucinated during GAN and Diffusion rendering.
source: Digital Pixel Thermodynamics & Spatial Forensics Archives
useCase: Brings the hammer down symmetrically on suspiciously 'flawless' skin or empty skies, mathematically proving they are composed of synthetic plastic rather than organic material.

references.title: Fridrich, J., et al. (2001). Detection of copy-move forgery in digital images. DFRWS.

strengths:
• Entirely bulletproof against geometric attacks like image rotation or flipping. Entropy physics are orientation-independent, obliterating any fraudster's attempt to rotate their way out of a conviction.
• Executes with hyper-velocity to pinpoint massive macro-structural failures routinely produced by Generative models.
limitations:
• Utterly impotent when faced with a natively pitch-black night sky or a perfectly smooth studio backdrop captured on high-end optics, where organic entropy is already dead, sparking severe False Positives.
• The radar crashes violently if the image is intentionally blasted with heavy film grain, maxing out the global entropy signature into artificial chaos.
